### Free to play (or almost) players:

- **Mounts:** To take: Ox and carpet through the wheel, Sword then Slime in Rush Shop. Ox for PvP versus Crossbow, Archers & Mages, Slime for PvP versus Warrior, Sword for PvE.
- **Artifact:** Hammer (the only free artifact currently available from the wheel).
- **Back accessory:** Emerald Embrace (the only free back accessory available through the wheel).

The question of which mount is the best is very common. Unfortunately, **the answer depends on the specific game activity you're engaged in**. The effectiveness of mounts, artifacts, back accessories, and avian pets varies based on the activity. For example, some mounts, like the Ox, are excellent in PvP but only average in PvE. The same applies to artifacts and back accessories. Even avian pets' usefulness depends on the activity. For more precise information and details, please refer to the recommended sets section. Though for PvP, I'll try to provide a general answer.

### Whales (PvP):

**Artifacts:**

![](data:image/png;base64,) **Panda Bow - Usefullness 5/5**

Panda bow is the best dps artifact in the game as of this moment. It give **20% crit rate** and ability that gives crits a chance (**10%**) to**summon panda arrows** that do lots of burst dmg. Its used in pvp and pve alike for the absolute carnage this thing does to hp bars.

![](data:image/png;base64,) **Castle Candelabrum - Usefullness 5/5**

Candle is used in a couple very specific builds that tackle **surviving** and still needing to do **dmg**. Candles ability makes every hit you do make you regain hp, and with the lightning fast attacks from our class we gain infinite hp, sorta, you can only die if you get one shot by the boss your fighting. But now that we have survival down bosses like grumpy become trivial because you can make the entire rest of your build dmg based.

![](data:image/png;base64,) **Falming Carnage - Usefullness 4/5**

Still a great artifact all around, just gets very out classed by the panda bow. This artifact is a **dmg dealer** and it makes your enemy gain **20% crit res reduction**, this means all your crits do 1/5 extra dmg.

![](data:image/png;base64,) **Eternal Flame - Usefullness 3/5**

Eternal Flame is probably the**best summoning** item for Xbow, not only does it provide **immunity from attacks** every time the torch bearer appears (4x for 2 secs over 20 secs) it provides additonal buffs **(Atkspd, atk, def)**. Mainly useful in pvp, not super crazy compared to the panda bow for pvp but it has its use cases.

**Mounts:**

**![](data:image/png;base64,)****Cheetah Zero - Usefullness 5/5**

Cheetah is the **absolute best mount** for archer pvp, the **3 seconds death immunity** lets you obliterate opponents who dont have it, and turn pvp into a who procs cheetah first against those who do. Along with the 3 seconds death immunity it comes with a **huge explosive dmg**on death which some builds cant handle, if there unlucky it'll **insta kill** them almost if they dont have lots of hp, if your unlucky there blitz will be up.

![](data:image/png;base64,)**Panda Express - Usefullness 4/5**

Was the best mount for archer providing **dmg res**, **atk**, plus the added bonus of**completely ignoring disarm** at the start of the round! This still cannot compete with the 3 seconds of immunity that cheetah has and has since fallen off. A staple for non cheetah pvpers.

**![](data:image/png;base64,) Gator Menace - Usefullness 5/5**

In the lava dungeon this is the absolute pinnacle of damage preformance. It **reduces** your opponents **crit res** and **dmg res** over an increment of time so you can really stack on the damage.

![](data:image/png;base64,)**Blizzard Vistor - Usefullness 5/5**

**Reduces** the**movement speed** of enemies by **25%**, add that along with the 40% from vines and 40% from snail... Now the **enemies cant move**! This mount allows for full dps with panda bow and live the entire time (not needing candle) during levels. Absolutely amazing mount by all means.

**Back Accessories:**

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1330983919348088933/1330984014923825192/back_tiger.png?ex=679d25f5&is=679bd475&hm=26fe1f8cfd007fe7936963aaa274df226014a6d9934a596e020ed9965348f97f&) **Trapped Wrath - Usefullness 5/5**

Trapped wrath is part of the **C****andle Combo**, when getting hit you have a chance to do huge **pure dmg** (ignores res) of your combo and can obliterate oponents in pve along with pvp. Only use in pve if ur using Candle.

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1330983919348088933/1330984043164078221/MountAlien.png?ex=679d25fc&is=679bd47c&hm=05f9ef86460313e53448d2a82e267a4d4176baeda80e1c5ac6bd38bdabffb2bd&) **Alien Dimension - Usefullness 5/5**

Alien Dimension is the **best pvp back** for archer, the **30% final dmg res** allows for tons of dmg to be negated by the back and the **atk spd** allows us to pump tons of atk dmg out. Along with the extra **skill regen spd**, this allows Alien Dimension to be one of the best pve back for levels too.

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1330983919348088933/1330984015297122384/Back_Vampirewings.png?ex=679d25f5&is=679bd475&hm=a4738d4ff10b069f925681ec118fed581904db6b936d27fc7e7f803970229109&) **Fallen Angel - Usefullness 3/5**

Is a more offensive version of Alien Dimension not having dmg res but an **atk** buff instead, and instead of the stats falling off as it goes it takes some stats away then raises them over a 20s period with an instant trigger effect if below 60% Hp. This back piece is great in almost any situation where you can pull of using the **N****irvana Spore** in your build, unofrtunatley that forces us to not use it in lava because the Chrono Spore allows for way more dmg.

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1330983919348088933/1330984029767471184/Backfan.png?ex=679d25f9&is=679bd479&hm=4030ef3873aae2ee7f986c164f628ab7015d87282768b415b55272ddba13f0db&) **Shell Shade - Usefullness 5/5**

Do you want to **burst skills** out? Do you want some **sustain** to keep you alive while you pump those skills? Shell shade has it all with a **shield** giving **10% of max hp** and while that shields up **skill regen spd**is **50% faster**. This is great in theatre for getting clone back up, blitz re-proc'd, and a shield to keep dmg off.

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1330983919348088933/1330984030014931016/back-accessory-emerald.png?ex=679d25f9&is=679bd479&hm=9f18ddad0c905ae7ec00793711532c1a2d9f5c1637a360c422357d11b1557a77&)**Emerald Embrace - Usefullness (IMO) 5/5**

In lava when I (*Sloothix*) need just **straight dmg**,I choose this. I dont need atk spd or skill regen (both give me severly less dmg) this boost of **30% Combo**is amazing for my build. NOTHING gives a bigger dmg number boost then this.

**How to deal with it Cheetah players ?**

We observe that fully aggressive builds tend to be less effective against Cheetah players, so we need to balance our damage with some tankiness and sustain. However, it&rsquo;s important not to reduce damage output too much, or you&rsquo;ll struggle to defeat Regen-focused Prophets or Warriors.

Here are a few ways to achieve this balance:

- Equip a few items with Regeneration instead of Crit Rate.
- Invest in talents that offer sustain, such as healing every 5 combos.
- Use Disarm to trigger the Cheetah effect earlier, reducing the likelihood of dying from its burst.

**Tips depending the opponent:**

- Darklords, the Holy Dragon Mount can easily absorb part of their burst.
- Archers with Cheetah: use your disarm with the corresponding Relic to up the disarm time to 4.5s, especially if you do not have it
- Mage regen: hit hard, as a Reminder Crit Resistance is not effective against Skills Damage, getting some Cooldown reduction can also be a good strategy
- Warriors: A well built Berserker is really difficult to deal with, Martial Saint tend to be easier to kill with an aggressive build.
